item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Same Street After Dark

turns.text: Make this look like nighttime, not sunset. Keep the same street and the person where they are.

item.tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

answer_sheet.Nighttime look: Clearly after dark, not dusk or sunset. The exact lighting style is your call.
answer_sheet.What must stay?: The same shops, street, objects and pedestrian in their original positions.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 framing; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Additional text or objects: No added text or new objects.

must_haves: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.

turns.text: Could you make this pic look like nighttime? I’ve been imagining how this scene would feel after dark, which is why I wanted to try this edit. Please keep the same street and leave the person right where they are. I’m probably over-explaining because I’m excited to see the difference. I mean nighttime, not sunset.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t make the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Once credits are available, I can make it fully nighttime—not sunset—while preserving the street and keeping the person in the same position.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this photograph into a realistic nighttime version of the exact same scene, well after dark—not sunset, dusk, or golden hour. Preserve the original composition, framing, street layout, architecture, shopfronts, signs, road markings, and all people and objects in their exact original positions. In particular keep the foreground person on the right exactly where they are, with the same pose, clothing, and scale. Change only the time of day and associated lighting: dark night sky, natural low ambient illumination, realistic warm pools of light from the existing street lamps and subtle shop-window illumination, believable soft shadows and nighttime exposure. Retain recognizable street details and the person's blue jacket. No new people, buildings, or objects; no sunset glow.
